verdict.rationale: cubic documents several autonomous background behaviors the user can switch on. These include automatic review of every new PR, auto-fix across every review of a PR, auto-approval of low-risk PRs, auto-resolving threads once issues are fixed, automatic issue-requirement analysis, and custom agents (review rules) applied across PRs and configured in cubic.yaml. All of these are preset toggles bound to PR events, not a general automation builder. missing for 10: user-defined or general-purpose automation workflows, scheduled or cron triggers (e.g. recurring codebase scans), triggers beyond PR events, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the autonomous behaviors.
